BEHIND THE WEBSITE

How This Website Was Made

DoWeo started as an idea to make it easier for friends to track and settle shared expenses. Here’s how the website came together.

  1. 1
    💡

    The Idea

    A simpler way to keep track of shared costs, see who owes whom, and automatically calculate balances.

    The beginning
  2. 2
    💻

    Built with Netlify

    The first working version of DoWeo was created with Netlify’s AI website builder.

    First version
  3. 3
    🗄️

    Added Supabase

    Supabase brought user accounts, profiles, shared trackers, expenses, and the database behind the app.

    The foundation
  4. 4
    ☁️

    Moved to Cloudflare Pages

    The website moved to Cloudflare Pages, with code managed through GitHub and server-side features connected to Supabase.

    New home
  5. 5
    👥

    Added More Features

    Expense splitting, Smart Settle-Up, group chat, notifications, friends, receipt tools, and tracker customization made DoWeo more useful.

    Growing
  6. 6
    📈

    Constantly Improving

    DoWeo continues to evolve through testing, fixing bugs, and ideas from the people who use it.

    Ongoing
OUR MISSION

Less confusion. More time together.

DoWeo was built to make managing shared money effortless, so you can focus on what actually matters — your friends, experiences, and memories.

DOWEO PAYMENT

Apple Cash via Messages

AMOUNT TO SEND
$0.00
Paying

Apple Cash contact
Copy Amount & Open Messages ↗
Pay with Apple Cash in Messages
  1. 1Tap Copy Amount & Open Messages to copy the amount (including $) and open the recipient’s conversation.
  2. 2Paste the amount in Messages. If it appears as a tappable amount, tap it to prepare Apple Cash; otherwise use the Messages + menu to choose Apple Cash manually.
  3. 3Review and authorize only an intended transfer. Once completed, return here to log it in DoWeo.

DoWeo can open Messages and copy the amount, but cannot send or verify Apple Cash transfers. Only log a payment you've completed.
